description: A shell script for testing various git commit functionalities, including commit creation, amendments, message handling, sign-off, date setting, and conflict resolution scenarios.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to stdout or a file.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in input.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for equality.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the fake time used in tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the input is empty.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares two diff outputs for equivalence.
